figures.caption: Figure 1: Summary of our Plural Reference Circuit. We identify Pronoun Interpretation Head, where entities attend to previous mentions (he → John; her → Mary). Plurality Formation Head finds the plural construction that forms a plural entity and attends to them. In contexts where a plural entity is not preferred (Mary and her bike), attention to the plural construction is incomplete. Such representation is then sent to the Pronoun Selection Head, where the LLMs decide which pronoun to predict and attend to the corresponding antecedents.
